summary: Pan American Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K announcing its plan to release second quarter 2026 unaudited financial results after market close on August 12, 2026, with a conference call and webcast on August 13, 2026. This is a routine earnings release notice, not a special situation. The filing provides dial-in details, webcast link, and meeting logistics. No special-situation transaction, activist, strategic review, or corporate action is described. The registrant is a Canadian foreign private issuer filing under Rule 13a-16. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes to analyze.
